findings.text: the fragment states the reader's gate is green by delta on "all nine covered files", but the brief's done_when (2) names ten and tests/test_iter_sectioned_conductor_set.py has no base arm, no head arm and no mention anywhere in the run directory, so a named gate file is silently renumbered away and an unmeasured file reads as measured.

the nine final-head re-runs carry no revision, tree or command header and no bare EXIT=<code> last line, so the arm that actually matches head 2319a6e58 cannot be tied to a revision or given a readable exit status from the log itself.

the fragment names head2-*.log as the arms re-run at the head as finally committed, but every head2 log predates 505298bfd and 2319a6e58 (head2-test_pointconstraint.log shows 5 passed where the final test file has 6) and the timings the table quotes, 94.72 s and 7.30 s, come from repair2-*.log, so the sentence attributes the final-head evidence to a superseded set.

the tests line is a template carrying <writable>, <tree> and <file> placeholders rather than the literal command that ran, and baseline_suite/after_suite at lines 17-18 are prose, so promotion cannot re-run the gate or read failure_count and exit_status from the manifest fields.
_vacuum_field re-implements the identical _vacuum_field at nova/imas/plasma_source.py:25, in the same package and in files this node edited, so the b0-by-index rule now has two owners.

int(self.homogeneous_time) is a real and needed store fix, but the brief admits scenario.py for a sign site only and this is a serialisation change, so the node added a condition rather than meeting it.

item_verdicts.diff: read all fourteen commits from be0ec1321 to 2319a6e58 commit by commit; ten files changed, 696 insertions and 47 deletions, carrying the reader translation and refusal, the wall dd_version, the scenario serialisation fix, the cache-convention refusal on load, the inverse sign drop, the shared GetSlice.translated seam, the new signed test file, the two folded review items and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names signed COCOS 17 assertions on CORSICA 130506/6 and DINA 105069/3 plus refusal of DINA 105014/1 and 105013/1 by digit; tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py:120-208 asserts exactly those against the raw DBEntry read and records 6 passed, 1 xfailed in 177.32 s, but the ten-file delta gate named in clause (2) has an arm for only nine of its files.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to move the xarray equilibrium reader and GetSlice onto translate_equilibrium and carry the one dependent internal sign site; nova/imas/equilibrium.py:504-611 adds convention_fields, check_convention and build_convention, :975/:979 invoke them from EquilibriumData.build, and nova/equilibrium/inverse.py:248-252 drops the compensating negation with its reason stated.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at manifest.md; status complete with fourteen commits listed, the round-3 cache finding answered by 505298bfd, and an admissible negative control named at line 22, but baseline_suite (line 17) and after_suite (line 18) are prose rather than the required single-line JSON and the tests line (15) is a template carrying <writable>, <tree> and <file> placeholders instead of the command that ran.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths against every diff path; all twelve changed paths are inside them, though nova/imas/scenario.py:89 is admitted by the brief for a sign site only and this change is not one.

justifications.durability: tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py:138-148 fails if GetSlice.translated stops converting (evidenced by the recorded bypass log), tests/test_pointconstraint.py:50-76 fails if inverse.py:252 restores its negation (evidenced by logs/negative-control-inverse-negation-restored.log), and tests/test_database.py:181-234 fail on either side of the cache check (evidenced by logs/negative-control-stale-cache-reverted.log), and no added assertion compares a value against an input the test itself supplied without an independently derived expectation.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py records 6 passed and 1 xfailed in 177.32 s and the negative control logs/negative-control-bypassed-translation.log reddens the psi1d assertion at 104.58 against -104.58, but tests/test_iter_sectioned_conductor_set.py, one of the ten files the done_when names, has no base or head arm anywhere in the run directory, and the final-head re-runs in logs/repair2-*.log carry no revision, tree or command header and no EXIT sentinel.
justifications.fit: nova/imas/equilibrium.py:504-545 follows the surrounding class-attribute and cached-property idiom and introduces no forbidden name, though self.data[name] = (self.data[name].dims, values) at :627 is a less idiomatic xarray update than the surrounding appends and check_convention at :544 repeats the eight-line translate_equilibrium construction of build_convention at :590.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/equilibrium.py:581-628 converts every field of convention_fields per slice through translate_equilibrium and records data.attrs["cocos"] at :628, EquilibriumData.load at :934-960 refuses a cached dataset under another convention, and inverse.py:252 carries the sign once, so the goal is met on both the build and the load path.
justifications.reuse: the reader extends the owners rather than forking them (nova/io/sourcemap.py:921 translate_equilibrium for both the factor map and the refusal, nova_cocos for the factors, nova/imas/getslice.py:37 for the field read, and nova/imas/plasma_source.py's private _translated is deleted in favour of that seam), but nova/imas/equilibrium.py:538 adds _vacuum_field, the same three-line b0-by-index rule already owned by nova/imas/plasma_source.py:25, and the signal-map construction is written twice.
justifications.scope_discipline: every diff path is inside the manifest's declared write paths, but nova/imas/scenario.py:89 is a zarr-serialisation fix in a file the brief admits only for a sign site, and nova/imas/equilibrium.py:988-997 (the wall dd_version) is a machine-read correction the goal does not imply.
